package loadtest

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	generated "GENRE_MODULE/loadtest/protocol"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/msgid"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/action"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/protocol"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/runner"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/scenario"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/session"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/transport"
)

// KindReconnect 是 Robot 换了 TCP 连接之后接管自己席位的请求（服务端转 room 模块的 RoomReconnect，应答带新代际）；
// 只有房间玩法（回合 PvP、合作）用。真实客户端直接发 room 模块自带的 RoomReconnect 协议。
const KindReconnect = "reconnect"

// Step 描述一个业务动作及其预期结果；身份只由鉴权提供。Request.Epoch 为 0 时用本 Robot 最近一次成功接管拿到的代际
// （第一次接管必须显式给出席位当前的代际，来自 RoomJoin / 上次接管的应答）；非 0 原样发送（用来验证旧代际被拒）。
// Reconnect 为动作前重建 TCP 连接；房间玩法在新连接上的第一步应是 KindReconnect。
type Step struct {
	Request   pb.ScenarioCommandRequest
	WantCode  int32
	Revision  uint64
	Reward    int32
	Reconnect bool
}

// Commands 按步骤发 ScenarioCommand：同一回执的重放只用于功能验收，不能用其结果声明服务器容量。
func Commands(cfg runner.Config, auth robot.AuthProvider, steps []Step) *runner.Runner {
	protocols := protocol.NewRegistry(nil)
	generated.RegisterDefaults(protocols)
	scenarios := scenario.NewRegistry()
	steps = append([]Step(nil), steps...)
	scenarios.MustRegister(scenario.New("commands", scenario.NodeFunc(func(ctx context.Context, rb *robot.Context) error {
		if len(steps) == 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("empty business scenario")
		}
		if err := rb.Do(ctx, action.NameConnect, nil); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		epoch := uint64(0)
		for i, step := range steps {
			if step.Reconnect {
				if err := rb.Do(ctx, action.NameConnect, nil); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
			request := step.Request
			if request.Epoch == 0 {
				request.Epoch = epoch
			}
			callCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
			m, err := rb.Session().CallChecked(callCtx, msgid.MsgScenarioCommand, msgid.MsgScenarioCommand, &request, func(m *session.Message) error {
				v, ok := m.Value.(*pb.ScenarioCommandResponse)
				if !ok {
					return fmt.Errorf("invalid response")
				}
				if v.Code != 0 {
					return session.ErrRejected
				}
				return nil
			})
			cancel()
			if err != nil && !(step.WantCode != 0 && errors.Is(err, session.ErrRejected)) {
				return fmt.Errorf("step %d: %w", i, err)
			}
			v, ok := m.Value.(*pb.ScenarioCommandResponse)
			if !ok || v.Code != step.WantCode || (v.Code == 0 && (v.Revision != step.Revision || v.Reward != step.Reward)) {
				return fmt.Errorf("step %d: unexpected result %+v", i, m.Value)
			}
			if v.Code == 0 && request.Kind == KindReconnect {
				epoch = v.Epoch
			}
		}
		return nil
	})))
	cfg.Scenario = "commands"
	cfg.Transport.Type = transport.PlayerTCPType
	return runner.New(cfg, runner.WithAuthProvider(auth), runner.WithProtocolRegistry(protocols), runner.WithScenarioRegistry(scenarios), runner.WithActionRegistry(action.NewRegistry()))
}
